style: 参考图A的粗轮廓与简化分块明暗；各单位体态由名称、器官和技能决定，保留细长、空心、几何和低伏结构，不统一堆成圆胖装甲。攻击特效独立保留。

units.design: Brick-red squat mutant goblin, orange eyes, navy scavenged chest harness, one rounded shoulder pad, ivory claw hands and digitigrade feet.
units.attack: 低身蓄力、单爪横扫、肩臂回收

units.design: Round orange volatile reactor crab robot, bright amber glass dome with simple molten blobs, dark navy metal lower collar, six short sturdy curved mechanical legs, small fuse knob on dome. No face, no humanoid torso. Legs have rounded mechanical joints and blunt pointed toes.
